verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Proton Pass can import passwords and other items from major password managers and can generate TOTP codes for saved logins. Nothing documents bulk-importing 2FA tokens from other authenticator apps, so the password-manager import tool is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand
